CustomField.formula: /* Comma-format with 3 decimals */ IF( cx_ln_Gross_Income__c < 1000, /* 0 - 999.999 */ TEXT(FLOOR(cx_ln_Gross_Income__c)) & "." & RIGHT("000" & TEXT( ROUND( (cx_ln_Gross_Income__c - FLOOR(cx_ln_Gross_Income__c)) * 1000 , 0) ), 3) , IF( cx_ln_Gross_Income__c < 1000000, /* 1,000 - 999,999 */ TEXT(FLOOR(cx_ln_Gross_Income__c / 1000)) & "," & RIGHT("000" & TEXT( FLOOR( MOD(cx_ln_Gross_Income__c , 1000) ) ), 3) & "." & RIGHT("000" & TEXT( ROUND( (cx_ln_Gross_Income__c - FLOOR(cx_ln_Gross_Income__c)) * 1000 , 0) ), 3) , /* 1,000,000 and above */ TEXT(FLOOR(cx_ln_Gross_Income__c / 1000000)) & "," & RIGHT("000" & TEXT( FLOOR( MOD(cx_ln_Gross_Income__c , 1000000) / 1000 ) ), 3) & "," & RIGHT("000" & TEXT( FLOOR( MOD(cx_ln_Gross_Income__c , 1000) ) ), 3) & "." & RIGHT("000" & TEXT( ROUND( (cx_ln_Gross_Income__c - FLOOR(cx_ln_Gross_Income__c)) * 1000 , 0) ), 3) ) )
CustomField.label: Gross Income
